text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Dedicated pool dp-orion-1 high utilization (tenant=orioncorp) — GPU util 95%, queued tasks 122, recent token latency spike. Pager -> oncall

ben_oncall: I'm on call. pinged infra, pulling graphs now. assigning to myself.

alice-sre: looking at prometheus: sustained GPU percent > 90% for 8m, avg token latency 1.2s, 120 pending async tasks. autoscaler didn't spin up — config min=4 max=6, ramp was too fast.

clara-eng: note: this is a single-tenant dedicated pool. we have a safety policy that prevents automatic overflow to shared infra without manual approval. we need ops sign-off to burst.

dave-support: customer impact: OrionCorp seeing 5xx on webhook processing and sync APIs. CS flagged 10% error rate in last 15m. Marta (Orion oncall) aware.

elena_cs: pinged Marta in their channel, asking them to pause noncritical jobs. they replied "we can throttle experiments, keep us updated".

ben_oncall: quick mitigation options: 1) manual scale dedicated pool +2 GPUs (takes ~4–6m), 2) short burst to hosted shared capacity for webhooks only (30m), 3) tenant-level throttle for long-running batches. propose doing 1+2+3 together. need approval from infra lead for burst.

alice-sre: I'll kick off resize job now. command: ```kubectl apply -f resize-dp-orion-+2.yaml``` estimated pod startup ~4m. also evicting idle workloads: ```kubectl drain dp-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

clara-eng: for tenant throttle we can set queue_limit and deprioritize batch jobs. admin API: ```curl -X POST "https://control.internal/admin/tenants/orioncorp/throttle" -d '{"queue_limit":40,"priority":"service"}'``` — that will keep interactive latency lower.

dave-support: CS prefers fallback for webhook traffic to hosted model variant while we stabilize. small degradation acceptable.

elena_cs: Marta approved a temporary fallback and will pause experiments. confirmed they want live updates.

ben_oncall: I approve a 30m burst to hosted capacity and the manual +2 GPU resize. @alice-sre go ahead. I'll coordinate communications. :thumbsup:

alice-sre: resize job submitted, status: "Scale request accepted". starting node provisioning. current queued tasks dropping from 122 -> 68.

incident-bot: UPDATE: dp-orion-1 active GPUs increased to 6, queued tasks 18, GPU util down to 62%. latency trending to normal.

clara-eng: follow-up action: add a capacity-safeguard rule — alert at 90% for >5m and auto-create preapproval task for 1-GPU burst for single-tenant pools. I'll open a ticket.

ben_oncall: good mitigation. I'll leave a note in the incident log and hand off to night oncall in 30m. tagging @eve-nightly for takeover.

eve-nightly: taking over at handoff. I'll monitor queue and confirm rollback of burst and scale-down at 00:10 UTC. please DM if anything degrades.

ben_oncall: final — major customer impact mitigation successful, CS to follow up with post-incident summary. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
